VIDEO SCRIPT: STANDING FIRM IN FAITH
Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Standing Firm in Faith. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• name the city where believers were first called Christians
• retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
• explain why they should not join ungodly groups

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: name the city where believers were first called Christians
• Model 2: retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
• Model 3: explain why they should not join ungodly groups

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: name the city where believers were first called Christians
• Practise: retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
• Practise: explain why they should not join ungodly groups

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Standing Firm in Faith.”
